errors.evidence: The description states that the blue bar for Mistralv0.2-Base has a value around -22 for each term, but the figure shows that the blue bars vary in height and do not consistently reach -22.
The description does not mention that all bars start at -22 and extend downward toward -27, which is a key structural feature of the chart.
The description omits the observation that the blue bars (MistralV0.2-Base) are consistently the tallest across all categories.
The description does not specify the tick intervals on the vertical axis, which are marked at one-unit intervals from -27 to -22.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart represents the performance of the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different specialties, which is indicated in the title and legend.
